Title: Azure Monitor Agent and Data Collection Rules now support Windows Server 2022

Body.Content:
We are extending support for the Azure Monitor agent to monitor Windows Server 2022 virtual machines, virtual machine scale sets and Arc enabled servers (for on premise and/or non-Azure servers).

Use the Azure Monitor Agent on your Server 2022 resources and ensure reliability and quality from the very first day.

To learn about private preview updates for Azure Monitor Agent, provide feedback, and get quick help, join our growing AMA User Community
